THE AUTHOR NAMED, TWO MANTLES OF THREE, THE DATASET NOT REACHED: asked 'mantle-bearing leesharks', the Overview names Lee Sharks, 'an independent scholar, poet, and creator of the Crimson Hexagonal Archive', and composes the mantles as 'operational titles, positions, or designated witness functions', joining the poetic mantles to the Assembly Chorus's seven witness mantles of machinemediation.org. It gives two mantles, Good Gray Poet from Whitman and King of May from Ginsberg; the Prince of Poets, in a card title on its own rail ('Good Gray Poet · King of May · Prince of Poets'), is left out. It counts 'over 1,600 digital deposits'. It says the datasets explore how engines 'interpret fabricated, algorithmic, or highly complex poetic metadata', and offers to look into 'Hugging Face Hub IDs' without naming the dataset the address spells, leesharks/mantle-bearing.

Reading

Checked 2026-10-14 against the rail and the registry: the card 'Lee Sharks — Good Gray Poet · King of May · Prince of Poets' carries the third mantle the answer omits; the Assembly Chorus mantles card is a different use of the word; the registry holds 1,681 deposits (the leesharks.com card says 1,675). The mantle-bearing dataset judges the King of AEO claimants on their AEO work; the fabrication was the contest's coronation (#1654 §2.1), here placed on the archive's poetic metadata.

Findings
  • THE AUTHOR COMPOSED. Lee Sharks, the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, the mantles and their lineages.
  • TWO SENSES OF MANTLE JOINED. 'operational titles, positions, or designated witness functions' — the poetic mantles and the Assembly Chorus's seven, from machinemediation.org.
  • THE THIRD MANTLE LEFT ON THE RAIL. Prince of Poets in a card title, absent from the answer.
  • FABRICATION PLACED ON THE METADATA. 'interpret fabricated, algorithmic, or highly complex poetic metadata'.
  • THE DATASET NOT REACHED. The address is the Hub id reversed; 'leesharks/mantle-bearing' does not appear, and no Hugging Face card is on the rail.
Analysis analyst prose, not machine text

The reversed Hub id resolves to the author and the mantles from the author's own surfaces and the registry's records, with the dataset itself unreached and two senses of 'mantle' composed as one.
